svg.aria-label: Panel one, similar motion: Start C4 + E4, end D4 + F4. The lower voice moves from C4 to D4, up 2 semitones. The upper voice moves from E4 to F4, up 1 semitone. Major third to minor third. Panel two, strict parallel, outside the five main changes: Start C4 + E4, end D4 + F♯4. The lower voice moves from C4 to D4, up 2 semitones. The upper voice moves from E4 to F♯4, up 2 semitones. Major third to major third.
svg.title: Similar, and strict parallel

g.text: How to read this graphic: The top keyboard is
change 5 of the lesson: the two arrows are
different sizes and the interval shrinks. The
lower keyboard is the strict case, outside
the five changes: both arrows are the same
size and the end pair is a major third again.
Compare the two arrow pairs and the two end
